        subarrays.append((l-1, r-1))  # convert to 0-based
        ptr += 2

    # We'll iterate over all possible subsets using bitmask
    for mask in range(1 << m):
        count = [0] * n
        for i in range(m):
            if mask & (1 << i):
                l, r = subarrays[i]
                for j in range(l, r+1):
                    count[j] += 1
